source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES passes the human range label as one literal sensor name and truncates fallback inventory; it omits two identities, CEM slot/root-port/BDF/FRU topology, board-versus-card sensor source, population rules and complete UI/spec evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION requires separate slot records, exact physical/device mapping, empty-slot behavior and complete UI/spec correlation.

old_problem: The source range was treated as one likely invalid sensor operand. No evidence independently mapped slot 1 and slot 2 through chassis/riser/root-port to the installed FRU/BDF or distinguished a board-local slot-air probe from card-internal telemetry, allowing swapped enumeration, empty-slot ambiguity or one card reading to masquerade as both sensors.
disposition_reason: Resolve two vendor-supported records independently and bind each to the physical CEM slot, riser/root port, installed-or-empty state, FRU/BDF and documented sensor source. Compare each complete OOB/two-UI record with its population-aware per-slot thermal specification under the existing card/load/airflow state. Topology and values are Project parameters; no PCIe service, reset or load is required.
decision_basis: XLSX row 880, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, internal Script reference, selection manifest and historical record were directly reviewed.
The spaced tilde expression is source range notation, not proven IPMI syntax; two independently evidenced records are required.
Chassis slot labels, BMC indices and OS BDF enumeration can differ, and board-local slot air is not equivalent to card-internal telemetry.
ED-13 controls empty-slot N/A, ED-15 requires per-slot acceptance, ED-17 preserves logs, and ED-20 preserves both slots independently.

test_case.test_name: Verify CEM slot 1 and slot 2 temperature sensors independently by physical topology and sensing source
test_case.purpose: Verify the two CEM-slot temperature records are individually human readable in Dashboard and Server Health, correctly mapped to physical CEM/PCIe slots 1 and 2 and their board-local or card telemetry sources, and independently meet applicable value, units, health, threshold/hysteresis and freshness specifications at the recorded passive card and airflow state.
required_package: Exact chassis/board/riser/BMC/BIOS configuration and physical CEM slot 1/2 to root-port and PCIe BDF map
Per-slot installed/empty state plus add-in-card FRU, PN, serial, firmware/driver, power and link inventory
Per-slot physical sensing point and source path plus separate stable SDR/API and Dashboard/Server Health identities
Per-slot units/scaling, approved range or reference delta, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health, freshness and empty-slot rules
Recorded card workload/link/power, system load, fan mode/speeds, airflow, timestamps and approved tolerance/update-lag rules
Validated protected OOB/API/browser clients and pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual read-only method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear logs, remove/reseat a card, reset a PCIe device, change driver/link/power state, generate traffic or accelerator load, alter fan/airflow or write thresholds. Build a two-row chassis/riser/root-port/BDF/FRU/population/source matrix. Enumerate the complete sensor repository and resolve CEM slot 1 and slot 2 separately; do not use `TEMP CEMSlot 1~2` as one literal record unless explicitly documented. Review the Script before use. Capture each independent command status, stable identity, value, units, capability/threshold/hysteresis, health and timestamp plus its matching Dashboard and Server Health rows. Compare each with its per-slot specification under the recorded passive state. Stop without retry on missing, duplicate, swapped, stale or divergent identity.
test_case.expected_result: Two distinct applicable records and UI rows map to the correct physical CEM slots, root ports, installed-or-empty state, FRUs/BDFs and documented sensing sources. Each independently matches its thermal value/unit/threshold/status/freshness specification under the recorded passive state. Empty-slot behavior follows the approved rule; one slot or generic/card telemetry never substitutes for both and no device state is mutated.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires physical/logical topology, population/source proof and separate complete OOB/two-UI/spec agreement for both applicable slots with an engineer verdict. One literal range query, OS enumeration alone, one slot, label-only matching, truncated output or unmapped card telemetry cannot pass. Missing/swapped/duplicate/stale identity, unjustified N/A, out-of-tolerance value or required threshold/status mismatch is FAIL. Missing topology/spec/reviewed method is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS; PCIe functionality, load response, hot-plug and reset are outside scope.
safety_gate: Do not clear SEL/system logs; PCIe, card, thermal and BMC history is relevant identity and health context.
Do not interpret the range as one sensor; preserve two independent results and statuses.
Do not infer physical slot from BDF/enumeration order or equate board-local slot air with card-internal telemetry.
Do not remove/reseat/reset a card, change driver/link/power/load/fan/airflow or write thresholds.
Use population and threshold capability rules; an empty slot may retain a board-local sensor and N/A needs specification proof.
Do not truncate output, expose credentials or run an unreviewed Script; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Chassis/board/riser/BMC/BIOS identity, physical slot-to-root-port/BDF map and installed/empty card PN/serial/FRU/firmware inventory
Two separate complete raw identities, sensing-source paths, values, units, threshold capabilities/values, health and timestamps
Separate Dashboard and Server Health evidence for each slot
Per-slot specification plus passive card link/workload/power, system load, fan and airflow state and tolerance/update-lag comparison
Empty/missing/duplicate/swapped/stale and card-versus-board-source disposition with pinned Script or alternate-method audit
No-clear/no-write/no-service/no-reset/no-load/no-retry proof, final PCIe/BMC health and per-slot engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On topology, source or identity ambiguity, stale/divergent values or unexpected PCIe/BMC health change, stop and preserve both slots' first evidence plus inventory/link state. Use approved read-only PCIe/BMC diagnostics; do not reset or reseat hardware to force evidence. Any independently authorized change is restored only by the platform owner.

source_conflict.reason: Items, UI Procedure and Criteria consistently request passive temperature validation for CEM slots 1 and 2. Literal range syntax and missing topology are readiness issues, not source-purpose conflict.
